entries.3cbcffc1bbcc6442: A service that provides client companies with an SMS and RCS delivery platform. Client companies operate the Company's delivery management screen or use an API (a mechanism that connects pieces of software) to deliver SMS and RCS to general consumers' mobile devices through mobile carriers' networks. It is used for identity verification, business communications such as notifying registered temporary staff of interview dates, reservation confirmations and shipping notices, promotions, and payment reminders to delinquent customers. Revenue consists of initial customization fees and monthly usage fees based on the number of messages delivered and similar factors. Costs include the fees paid to mobile carriers for SMS and RCS delivery and server usage fees. In the sales results table, it is the largest category in the sales of the Smart AI Engagement Business, and the year-on-year figure was 106.97%.

entries.580d534bcbf4e7b1: This is a segment that, with a view to the entire points of contact between companies and customers, consistently supports marketing activities from design through operation and improvement, covering advertising planning and promotion, creative production, upstream strategy formulation and marketing research, and media development and operation. Rōpu Co., Ltd., which became a subsidiary through a share acquisition in October 2025, is responsible for this segment. Because Rōpu has been consolidated since October 2025, revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥137,194 thousand and segment profit was ¥12,570 thousand, covering only the three months from October to December. As it was not consolidated in the previous year, no comparison with the previous year is given. The securities report states that the company focused on winning and expanding projects centered on its key business partners.
entries.59db3a37a9eea321: The Group consists of the company and two consolidated subsidiaries (AIX Tech Ventures Co., Ltd. and Roup Co., Ltd.). The company has set the mission 'Smart Work, Smart Life: Continuing to create good moments in life.' The company is the entity that took over the SMS two-way distribution platform that had been operated by AOS Technologies Co., Ltd.

entries.8c88a4166db3200a: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the Group (the company and two consolidated subsidiaries) operates a corporate messaging service as its core business and is working to expand its AI-related business. Its central Smart AI Engagement Business provides corporate clients with distribution platforms for SMS and RCS, and also offers Deep Predictor, a no-code AI analysis tool. Following the acquisition of Roup Co., Ltd. as a subsidiary in October 2025, the company added the Marketing Solutions Business, which provides advertising planning and marketing support, to its reportable segments from the current period. The annual securities report states that, under its medium-term management plan, the company is advancing a 'model shift from providing messaging service platforms to providing marketing solutions combining messaging services and AI.' Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,151,609 thousand.
entries.a42a3c4f9c50c4a1: Client companies send SMS or RCS messages to general consumers' mobile devices through mobile carriers' networks, using the company's distribution management screen or API. In addition to client companies, the company also contracts with sales companies (hanbaisha) and aggregators (companies that bundle distribution demand and send messages in large volumes). 12.1% of consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 came from Jintekku Co., Ltd.
entries.a6ae961d13fab0aa: A segment that provides businesses with messaging delivery services such as SMS (short messages that can be sent using only a phone number) and RCS (its next-generation international standard), and a no-code AI analysis tool; it is the core of the Group. It supports improved engagement (strength of connection) and greater operational efficiency by making communication between companies and their customers more advanced. Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥4,014,415 thousand (up 8.3% year on year), and segment profit was ¥1,050,679 thousand (up 20.1% year on year). The securities report gives as the reasons that the Company focused on highly profitable domestic customers, carried out measures for each industry centered on finance and staffing-related services, and provided integrated solutions combining SMS with AI.

entries.d10cf1d4b5293f53: Businesses using SMS and RCS, and business partners in advertising and marketing
entries.d4788cd0f2132b00: It provides SMS and RCS distribution services used for identity authentication, business notices, notifications of reservation confirmations and shipments, promotions and payment reminders, as well as the no-code AI analysis tool and advertising planning and marketing support. The annual securities report states that the reason SMS and RCS are used is that they allow contact with general consumers at a relatively low cost compared with conventional means such as telephone, email and postal mail. Because the company uses the official distribution routes of mobile carriers, it has direct contracts with all mobile carriers.
entries.d48150c5f21c3ba0: A company that provides SMS and RCS delivery services and AI analysis tools for businesses, and also handles marketing support.
entries.d77f2e7016f658c4: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥370,599 thousand (up 10.6% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥366,316 thousand (up 12.3%), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥165,246 thousand (up 11.3%). The annual securities report states that profit of the Smart AI Engagement Business increased due to factors including a focus on highly profitable domestic clients. For investment securities held by AIX Tech Ventures, a consolidated subsidiary, the company recorded a valuation loss of ¥13,035 thousand. In addition, the company borrowed ¥230,000 thousand each from Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation and Mizuho Bank to fund the acquisition of Roup shares.
entries.d7e9ca03ee5a8fde: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,151,609 thousand, an increase of 12.0% from the same period of the previous year. Revenue of the Smart AI Engagement Business was ¥4,014,415 thousand (up 8.3% year on year), and revenue of the Marketing Solutions Business was ¥137,194 thousand. The latter is for October to December of Roup, which was consolidated in October 2025.
entries.ec8c064d2d390267: A service whose main offering is the no-code AI analysis tool "Deep Predictor", which lets anyone perform, through an intuitive interface, AI analysis that data scientists previously carried out, and which provides plans and customization suited to each client company's issues. It supports corporate decision-making and the promotion of DX (digital transformation of operations). In the sales results table, the year-on-year figure was 215.13%. It is a category with smaller sales than the messaging services.
